title: Mermaid Roshan and the Song Beneath the Pool
artifact_type: revised manuscript and sequential-action staging proof
acceptance_limits: No new action illustration, illustrated-book, runtime, cinematic, owner, child or print acceptance is claimed.

page_layout.title: Mermaid Roshan and the Song Beneath the Pool
A little voice. A whole city listening.

text_bounds.text: Cover: Roshan leads a low swimming arc; Rumi, Hana and Nari behind her, Duri beside her. Pearl bridge and shell stage establish one connected under-pool city. Cover art is a separate pending view.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: An undersea adventure with Rumi
Pool-room establishing view. Preserve the seahorse fountain and turning rainbow.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: The castle's candle was still missing. In Rumi's pool, the rainbow kept turning.
Roshan watches Rumi warm up, then touches her own throat. Invitation has a real personal purpose.

text_bounds.speaker: Rumi
text_bounds.text: Come sing with us tonight!

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: What if my voice is too little?
Rumi offers a hand; Roshan chooses to take it.

text_bounds.speaker: Rumi
text_bounds.text: You can start beside me.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Roshan wanted to try. She took a breath and followed Rumi down.
Broad geography: bridge/tram left, music room centre, bathhouse nearby, shell stage with lower current arch right. Pool portal remains above the city.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Below the pool lay curved roofs, lantern lanes and gardens of waving kelp.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: We're still in Pearl Castle?

text_bounds.speaker: Rumi
text_bounds.text: Every bit!
A blue current thread passes music room, then stage arch, then curls toward shops, bathhouse and tram; arrows belong only to planning, no new power source.

text_bounds.speaker: Rumi
text_bounds.text: The current carries our evening song. The shops answer, then the bathhouse, then the tram.
Residents prepare for the evening; projected shop pictograms, shell bowls and peach window lamps.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Windows were opening. Tables were filling. Soon, the first song would begin.
Bubble tram approaches overhead. A loose kelp leaf traces the low clear arch.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Roshan raced after the tram bubbles.

text_bounds.speaker: Rumi
text_bounds.text: Our path is underneath. Watch the leaf.
Tram passes; one short water pulse bends the kelp. Rumi rests a hand on the pillar; Roshan copies.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: WHOOSH! The passing tram swept the water sideways.

text_bounds.speaker: Rumi
text_bounds.text: Hold here. Let the rush pass.
Pulse settles; both follow the leaf around the pillar instead of fighting against it.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: Now it curves this way!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: She slowed her tail. The water carried them through.
Duri with his basket of small bells and a stage banner. Mint floral shell and four lavender flippers fully readable.

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.text: I'm Duri. These bells invite our neighbours to the song. This banner goes to the stage.
One bell drifts to kelp; Roshan uses the curling current learned on p4.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Ding! One bell escaped. Roshan followed the leaf, turned low and caught it.

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.text: You saw the little way through!
Duri points to the bridge route, then his bulky banner. Roshan offers to share the load.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: Can we help carry it?

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.text: I'll manage. Meet you after my round!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Off he paddled, basket wobbling.
Music room: Rumi joins tall copper-haired Hana and younger navy-bobbed Nari. Distinct costumes and one-tail anatomy.

text_bounds.speaker: Hana
text_bounds.text: I'm Hana. I dance BIG!

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.text: I'm Nari. I hear tiny things.
Hana begins a broad turn; her costume ribbon brushes Nari. Nari holds her small shell drum.

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.text: Room for one small drummer, please!

text_bounds.speaker: Hana
text_bounds.text: Oops. Smaller turn.
Hana makes room; Roshan sits inside the trio formation rather than outside it.

text_bounds.speaker: Rumi
text_bounds.text: We take turns. Sing, listen, answer.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: I can try the listening part.
Trio begins a quiet original refrain. Roshan watches their breathing.

text_bounds.speaker: Trio
text_bounds.text:
Little voice, big blue sea.
Sing with you, sing with me.
Hana encourages enthusiastically; Nari makes a gap between drumbeats for Roshan.

text_bounds.speaker: Hana
text_bounds.text: Your turn!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Roshan tried a note. It vanished beneath the drum.

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.text: I'll leave you a space.
Nari pauses; the trio listens. Roshan tries again, heard at close range.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: La...

text_bounds.speaker: Rumi
text_bounds.text: There you are.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: For one little moment, Roshan liked her own voice.
The trio sends the next line toward the open windows; map echoes p3 landmarks.

text_bounds.speaker: Trio
text_bounds.text:
Make a space and let it through.
There's a place for me and you.
Three small views: quiet shop window, bathhouse curtain, tram ribbons barely moving.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: No answer from the shops. None from the bathhouse. Even the tram was quiet.

text_bounds.speaker: Hana
text_bounds.text: Maybe we need to sing louder?
Roshan hears an uneven tiny tap between the notes; her hand rises before Hana can drown it out.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: Wait. I heard something.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Tap. Tap. Then nothing.
Nari stops drumming. Roshan separates irregular tapping from a bell ringing.

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.text: A courier bell?

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: No. Someone is knocking.
They reach the bridge. Sound seems to come from two arches; show left kelp route and right open echo chamber.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Under the bridge, the tapping bounced from arch to arch.

text_bounds.speaker: Hana
text_bounds.text: This way!
Hana swims toward the loud echo, finds an empty recess and turns back. A meaningful wrong first route.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Hana found only stone. The loudest sound was an echo.
Roshan holds still; Nari leaves a silent gap. A faint tap comes from the low kelp arch.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: Let it finish.

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.text: There. Under the fronds.
Roshan follows a leaf toward the low arch. Rumi keeps Hana and Nari together.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: A little leaf curled into the same opening. Roshan followed it.
A tram approaches above. The fronds begin to lean; Roshan recognises the setup from p4.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: The tram! Hold the pillar.
Pulse passes; all four maintain their holds. No separation or injury.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: WHOOSH! Kelp streamed across the entrance. The friends held on.
Rumi keeps kelp aside once the pulse settles. Roshan leads with a small tail turn.

text_bounds.speaker: Rumi
text_bounds.text: Now. One at a time.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Roshan slipped low. Hana folded her great fan fin close.
Nari carries drum close to chest through the gap rather than letting it snag.

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.text: No big drumbeats here!
At the inner recess they see Duri tapping from between two crates. Clear establishing view before close-ups.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Beyond the kelp, a lantern lit two crates. Between them was Duri.
Two empty concert prop crates rest on a sloping stone ledge. Duri fits between them but cannot turn his shell. Banner loop catches his shell and nearer crate corner.

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.text: I tried to move these boxes out of the path. They slid together.
Close on loop and floral shell; no neck constriction, wounds or frightening crushing.

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.text: Then the banner caught. I can paddle, but I can't turn.
Duri taps crate with one free flipper. Roshan answers by touching the same crate.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: We heard you. We're staying here.
Hana begins pushing the nearer crate; the cloth draws tight instead of freeing Duri.

text_bounds.speaker: Hana
text_bounds.text: I can make a space!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: The crate moved. The loop tightened.
Roshan immediately stops the push. All hands hold stable; Duri remains safe.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: Stop! That cloth has to come free first.
Overhead close plan: nearer crate/banner corner, Duri in gap, far crate held by Hana; same orientation as p11.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Roshan looked at the corner, the loop and Duri's shell.
Roshan gently moves nearer crate back just enough to slacken cloth, without undoing any completed rescue.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: A tiny bit this way.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: The loop loosened.
Rumi places fingers under loose fabric, clear hand-shell contact.

text_bounds.speaker: Rumi
text_bounds.text: I can lift it. Keep this crate still.
Roshan takes nearer crate; Hana far crate. Nari positions where she can see overhead tram and all hands.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: Hana, hold that one. Nari, watch the bridge.

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.text: I'll tell you when the water changes.
Rumi lifts the loop over the widest shell edge while Duri folds his flippers in.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Duri tucked in. Rumi lifted slowly. The cloth rose over his shell.
Banner is fully off Duri; the freed cloth floats above his shell. First concrete gained state.

text_bounds.speaker: Rumi
text_bounds.text: The loop is free!

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.text: I can turn a little!
Nari sees tram lanterns crossing above; kelp and hair bend before the pulse.

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.text: Here comes the rush! Hold!
Pulse nudges nearer crate along slope. Roshan braces; Hana keeps far crate stable; Rumi supports Duri.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: WHOOSH! Roshan's crate slid a hand-width. She planted both hands against it.
Duri's basket lifts; loose bells join it in one visible eddy/kelp pocket behind pillar, just beyond safe recess. No renewed cloth entanglement or offscreen lost bells.

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.text: My bells!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: His basket tipped into the curling water.
Roshan starts to reach for basket; crate begins turning. Her decision has an immediate visible consequence.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Roshan reached after it. The crate shifted.

text_bounds.speaker: Rumi
text_bounds.text: Stay with Duri. The bells can wait!
Roshan returns both hands to brace; Rumi keeps Duri safe. Nari tracks basket circling a clear recess behind pillar; no risky mid-rescue recovery.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Roshan held her place. Nari watched the basket circle behind the pillar.

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.text: I can still see it!
Pulse ends; Nari checks fronds, then counts. Hana and Roshan have maintained stable crate positions.

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.text: The water is quiet. One. Two. Gently.
Roshan slides nearer crate sideways off slope onto adjacent flat patch; Hana steadies far crate. Gap opens behind Duri.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Roshan pushed sideways. This time, the space stayed open.
Duri turns shell edge-on into newly opened gap and backs into Roshan's now-free hands, all four flippers free. Nearer crate rests on flat patch.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: Back toward me, Duri.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Four little flippers paddled. Duri backed clear.

Primary action: now Duri is free, Hana slides far bridge crate off slope onto separate flat patch. Roshan/Duri safe in supporting background; their clear offpanel speech continues. Both crates stable before departure.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Hana settled the other box on flat stone.

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.text: You didn't leave me.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: You kept tapping. We kept listening.
Now Duri is safely free, Nari points to same eddy/kelp pocket; Rumi follows curling water, scoops loose bells into basket then catches basket. No new trap or lost possessions.

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.text: There's the basket!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Rumi scooped the loose bells into it. The whole delivery came home.
Duri accepts shared carrying; Hana takes banner, Rumi basket. Nari taps a quiet reply.

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.text: Will you carry these with me?

text_bounds.speaker: Hana
text_bounds.text: Gladly.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Tap. Tap. Tap. This time, four friends answered.
Quiet mint tiled bathhouse. Duri's towel and all four flippers readable; Nari's cream bunny-ear towel appears here.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: At the bathhouse, warm water untangled their hair and hurried feelings.
Roshan and Duri share a candid closer view; others listen without talking over them.

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.text: I thought I had to carry everything myself.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: I nearly chased your bells. I forgot you needed my hands.
Rumi squeezes Roshan's hand. Roshan acknowledges reliance on the others.

text_bounds.speaker: Rumi
text_bounds.text: Then you stayed. We could help because you let us.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: I was scared. I'm glad you were there.
Hana notices Nari's towel ears; Duri relaxes flippers and laughs. Gentle landing after action.

text_bounds.speaker: Hana
text_bounds.text: Are we singers or sea bunnies?

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.text: Very clean sea bunnies!

Preserve selected lavish feast: wide coral table filling foreground, three piled clusters of gimbap/golden snacks, tiered sweets/side dishes and fruit, four shell cups. Original selected food/table source controls design.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Supper filled a great coral table: seaweed rolls, golden dumplings, fruit towers and little cakes.
Hana sprawls on cream couch; Duri waits for a small seat. Do not obscure Hana's face with repeated fin crops.

text_bounds.speaker: Hana
text_bounds.text: I dance BIG. I rest BIG too.

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.text: Room for one small turtle, please.
Hana folds long fin; Duri settles beside Roshan. Basket is parked safely nearby.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Hana folded her fin. Duri chose a tiny cake from an enormous plate.
Roshan starts quiet original line; friends join. Warm expressive group moment before interruption.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: Make a space and let it through.

text_bounds.speaker: Everyone
text_bounds.text: There's a place for me and you.
Same feast and cream couch. Magician enters through curtain with top hat; performer unfurls a banner with same motif as rescue cloth.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: POOF! A top hat bobbed through the curtain.

text_bounds.speaker: Magician Imp
text_bounds.text: Make way for our spectacular show!
Performer's banner floats above table without sweeping food away. Duri rises beside Rumi, recognises design.

text_bounds.speaker: Performer Imp
text_bounds.text: Enormous scenery! Enormous voices!

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.text: That's your banner. Your boxes trapped me.
Duri points toward stage; distinguish three additional gate crates from the two bridge crates.

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.text: I saw three more under the stage.

text_bounds.speaker: Magician Imp
text_bounds.text: Our finest props! Nobody touch them!
Imps hurry off to stage. Roshan makes a decision; trio follows, Duri can choose safe route with them.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: The city stopped answering. We need to see what those props are blocking.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: They left the feast and followed the banner.
Show stage above and golden current arch below: two small forward crates and one larger rear crate, independently floor-supported; weak blue thread beneath. Public song route visible beyond arch.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Three crates crowded the current arch. The ribbons above it hardly stirred.
Stage-side imps practise loud duet; voices remain nearby, distant windows remain quiet.

text_bounds.speaker: Performer Imp
text_bounds.text: LOUDER! Why won't anybody cheer?

text_bounds.speaker: Rumi
text_bounds.text: They can't hear you through all that scenery.
Roshan sees blue thread under large crate, tying to p4 leaf and rescue route.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: There's a little way through. But not enough room for the song.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: The magic was still there. The path was blocked.
Duri pauses near bridge after frightening experience; Roshan offers companionable hand/flipper contact, not a forced return.

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.text: I know the service passage. It's narrow.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: We'll go together.
Duri confidently leads low path behind pillar. Hana folds fin, Nari listens at bend; completed rescue not threatened.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Duri turned beneath the bridge. Hana followed with small, careful turns.

text_bounds.speaker: Hana
text_bounds.text: Big fin. Little doorway.
Passage opens beside right storage ledge below stage; show ledge clear, outside straight outflow and large enough for all three crates.

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.text: Here. I leave parcels on that flat ledge.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: A safe place for the props!

Clear spatial plan: arch centre/low, stage above, right storage ledge outside straight outflow, safe pillar left rear. Two small crates beside/in front of square-aligned large crate, all independently supported on floor; no stack.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: Move the small boxes first. Then the big one. Keep the arch clear.
Hana tests banner as a broad soft catcher; Nari taps and pauses; Duri observes ledge from safe pillar.

text_bounds.speaker: Hana
text_bounds.text: I can catch their flying props.

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.text: I can count the moves.

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.text: I'll watch the way out.
Rumi floats beside Roshan; request comes before combat. Nari's bathhouse towel was removed offpanel between17and18; mint hooded jacket/peach collar remain.

text_bounds.speaker: Rumi
text_bounds.text: I'll stay beside you.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: First, let's ask them to help.
Roshan faces costumed imps at shell stage. The three gate crates and unused right ledge visible in context; two bridge crates stay at bridge.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: Your bridge boxes trapped Duri. These ones are blocking our song. Will you move them?
Performer reacts defensively; motive is being heard, not a new evil conspiracy.

text_bounds.speaker: Performer Imp
text_bounds.text: We made the biggest show. We need the biggest scenery!
Roshan points to safe ledge and silent shop windows, offering concrete solution.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: It can stand here. Then your neighbours can answer.
Magician refuses, then begins bubble puff with purple hand. Preserve navy coat/top hat/red bow tie/trousers/shoes and original bare purple hands; no new gloves, cape or costume transformation.

text_bounds.speaker: Magician Imp
text_bounds.text: Nobody moves our props!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: He flicked his hand. POOF!
A directional bubble wall separates stage approach from crates. Roshan brakes; head and hands readable through clear space.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Bubbles rolled across the arch. Roshan stopped before they swept her sideways.
Performer tosses foam star; Hana opens rescue banner across its flight line.

text_bounds.speaker: Performer Imp
text_bounds.text: Our dazzling star!

text_bounds.speaker: Hana
text_bounds.text: Our very soft catcher!
Banner bows and catches star. Hana braces fin against stage edge while floating, no mermaid feet; Nari ducks clearly beneath it.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: WHUMP! The star landed in the cloth. Nari ducked beneath its corner.
Rumi starts a distinct original work-song; Hana/Nari join while catching/counting. Singing coordinates physical moves, never acts as an attack or removes crates.

text_bounds.speaker: Trio
text_bounds.text: Catch the star and let it sway.
Roshan watches rising bubbles, not trying to outsing them. Duri points to low current from safe pillar.

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.text: Below!

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: I see it.
Bubble wall cycles upward with a clear interval beneath. Roshan follows blue thread with her eyes.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: A puff rose. Another followed. Between them, the little blue current kept curling.
Nari leaves one drumbeat silent so she can hear the next puff starting.

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.text: Wait for it...
Magician draws breath for puff; Rumi pivots aside. Roshan remains braced until interval.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Rumi spun clear. The bubbles swept past the empty space.
Nari signals clear low interval. One readable diagonal dive, one-tail anatomy, no whole-body blur.

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.text: Now, Roshan!
Roshan folds low, swims beneath cloud and turns at pillar in same direction as learned p4 route.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Roshan dipped, turned and followed the blue thread under the bubbles.
She reaches first small crate from below. Establish successful position before next task; Rumi answers with next work-song line before following.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: I'm through. Rumi, this side!

text_bounds.speaker: Rumi
text_bounds.text: Make a little swimming way.
Rumi follows same timed gap. Hana holds foam catcher above; Nari counts from stage edge.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Rumi slipped through after her. Above them, Hana kept the star out of their way.
Roshan and Rumi each have visible two-hand contact on first small crate; slide to right ledge.

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.text: One. Two. Gently!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: The first little crate slid onto the flat ledge.
Duri confirms first crate flat/stable from nearby safe position, without heavy lifting.

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.text: It's flat. Leave it there!
Rumi and Roshan repeat with second small crate, altered approach because blue thread is clearer. First remains on ledge.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: The next one. Turn this corner toward me.
Second settles beside first; Nari sees ribbons begin stirring. Larger crate still blocks main arch. Rumi swims back up to stage, Roshan stays by large crate.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Two boxes out. The ribbons trembled. Rumi swam back up to the stage.

text_bounds.speaker: Rumi
text_bounds.text: One big box to go.

text_bounds.speaker: Trio
text_bounds.text: Leave a beat and keep it slow.
Performer pulls banner edge to reclaim star, making cloth taut. Hana stays balanced and offers release rather than tug-of-war.

text_bounds.speaker: Performer Imp
text_bounds.text: Give back our star!

text_bounds.speaker: Hana
text_bounds.text: Here it comes!
Hana tilts soft catcher and Nari tips star with drum rim, directing it to padded cushions already by performer. No hard strike.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Hana tipped the cloth. Nari nudged the foam star toward the cushion pile.
Star drifts into performer's arms; backward surprise step lands him on cushions, safe and comical.

text_bounds.speaker: Performer Imp
text_bounds.text: Oof!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: He sat down in a great squash of pillows.
Magician aims broad puff in response; own broad bubble stream lifts/tilts hat over eyes. Clear causal puff-hat contact detail, same costume.

text_bounds.speaker: Magician Imp
text_bounds.text: An even bigger POOF!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: His bubbles flipped his hat over his eyes.
Rumi offers elbow/hand to guide magician onto same cushions instead of leaving him blind to stumble.

text_bounds.speaker: Rumi
text_bounds.text: Cushions this way.

text_bounds.speaker: Hana
text_bounds.text: Big moves. Soft finish.
Residual final bubble puff drifts between Roshan below and friends above. Two cleared crates remain safe; no regression.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: The last big puff hid the arch. Roshan was already beside the final crate.
Hana passes the now-empty rescue banner down to Roshan through last thinning puff. Show explicit handoff; performer's interruption banner remains a different prop.

text_bounds.speaker: Hana
text_bounds.text: Try this!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Hana passed the soft banner down to Roshan.
Roshan loops freed end of banner through large crate handle; cloth can reach up to ledge, no tied actor limbs.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: I can pull it like the little ones.

She pulls straight toward right ledge; square crate skews diagonally and trailing corner catches a short side projection of right arch jamb. Floor is flat with open pivot space in front; no full-width threshold.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: The box moved, turned and stuck.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: Come on...
Close on caught corner, short side lip and taut cloth; she stops pulling, learned snag inspection echoed from p11.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: She pulled harder. The corner pressed harder too. Roshan let the cloth go slack.
Roshan calls to friends across residual bubbles; loud hiss masks call. Show why no immediate answer comes, rather than making friends ignore her.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: I need you!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: HISSS! The last puff rushed over her voice.
Bubbles hide hand signal but their hiss is fading. Roshan taps crate three times as Duri did in rescue; Duri hears knock through quieter interval from safe route.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: The bubbles hid her wave. She knocked instead. Tap. Tap. Tap.
Nari pauses drumming; Duri identifies Roshan's taps. Rumi and Hana turn toward arch.

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.text: That's Roshan!

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.text: Leave a space. Listen.
Friends use low gap; Duri guides along safe corridor, not through a renewed trap.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: They followed Duri beneath the last bubbles. Roshan was waiting, hands resting on the crate.
Duri points to short side projection/diagonal corner and demonstrates small turn with bell basket. Show free floor/pivot arc beside jamb, drawing on courier experience.

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.text: My parcels catch there too. Turn the corner first. Then slide.
Roshan assigns contacts: Hana pushes far corner into open forecourt; Roshan guides near corner; Rumi keeps banner slack during rotation; Nari counts; Duri watches from outside pivot path.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: Hana, turn that corner. Rumi, keep the cloth loose. Duri, tell us when it's clear.

Short rotation around floor-supported near corner swings caught trailing corner away from short jamb lip into open forecourt; show gained clearance before any sideways pull. Rumi's banner remains slack.

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.text: One. Two. Turn!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: The corner swung away from the stone.

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.text: Clear!
Maintain rotated crate from p27; after Duri's Clear, Rumi takes banner with Roshan and pulls; Hana supports far edge. Reset grips for sideways slide without losing orientation.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: Rumi, pull with me. Now slide. Together!
Crate moves onto right ledge beside two smaller crates; arch progressively revealed. Big action panel, consistent geography.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: SWISH! The last box slid clear. Three boxes rested safely at the side.
Full golden arch now clear. Blue current flows to shops/bathhouse/tram; hanging ribbons lift, no new magic source. Trio completes work-song after physical clearing.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: A blue ribbon of water curled through the arch. The stage ribbons lifted and danced.

text_bounds.speaker: Trio
text_bounds.text: Turn together. Let it flow.
Duri swims through safe cleared opening with basket and rings one bell. First reply reaches friends.

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.text: Time to finish my round!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Ding! A little answer came back from the first open window.
Both imps sit safely on pillows; quiet song reaches them. Performer looks at reopened route, not just defeat pose.

text_bounds.speaker: Performer Imp
text_bounds.text: They're singing now. Why didn't they sing for us?
Roshan points to clear arch and stable side props; explanation grounded in visible change.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: Your scenery blocked the way. A bigger show couldn't fix that.
Magician addresses Duri as he passes, with apology and an offered practical task.

text_bounds.speaker: Magician Imp
text_bounds.text: We didn't mean to trap you. Can we help?

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.text: Keep that path open.
Imps fold loose cloth/tidy cushions away from route. No reblocking or destruction of costume identity.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: They folded their banner and tucked the cushions safely beside the stage.
Hana gives them space at edge of ensemble, not exclusive centre. Nari sets a small answering beat.

text_bounds.speaker: Hana
text_bounds.text: There's room for your big moves too.

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.text: And a little pause after them!
Duri's genuine delivery sequence: first shop neighbour receives bell; chorus carried by clear current, no invented named cast.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Duri rang at the shops. One neighbour answered. Then two.
Bathhouse doorway: familiar mint tiles; another bell delivered, neighbours hum.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: He rang at the bathhouse. Warm voices joined the tune.
Tram platform: bell and fluttering ribbons. Tram passes without threatening cleared props; p4 pulse now harmless.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: At the tram, bells chimed. The song came all the way back.
Stage ensemble: trio plus Roshan, Duri returns to them, costumed imps at sides. Roshan starts her own note confidently.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: My turn.

text_bounds.speaker: Everyone
text_bounds.text:
Little voice, big blue sea.
Sing with you, sing with me.
Wide city response as map pays off. Hold uncluttered faces and broad expressive figures.

text_bounds.speaker: Everyone
text_bounds.text:
Make a space and let it through.
There's a place for me and you.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Roshan sang. Then she left a space for the answer.
Return via pool portal, same seahorse fountain and rainbow. Castle boundary explicit.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Roshan and Rumi swam back to the pool. The rainbow was still turning.
Quiet honest connection to wider unresolved story, no new quest or candle clue.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: We haven't found the candle.

text_bounds.speaker: Rumi
text_bounds.text: No. But you helped a whole neighbourhood find its voice.
Roshan chooses to answer distant courier taps with a tap of her own. Close the personal arc through action.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Far below came three little taps.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.text: I hear you.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: She tapped three times back.
Illustrated back: cast gathered in familiar neighbourhood, open arch and stored crates subtly visible. Separate future cover view, not a claimed existing action frame.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.text: Tap. Tap. Tap.
